title: Downtown Oasis | Walk to Broadway
description:
Looking for an unforgettable stay in the heart of Downtown Nashville? YOU JUST FOUND IT!

Welcome to our one-of-a-kind Airbnb at The Burnham Nashville – your perfect home base for exploring everything Music City has to offer!

Enjoy resort-style amenities including: a gym, pool, grill area, and fire pits! 

Broadway and Honky Tonks - 3 blocks
Bridgestone Arena - 2 blocks
Music City Center - 1 block
Nissan Stadium - 1 mile
Ascend Amphitheater - .4 miles
The Gulch - .5 miles

The space
Not only are you steps away from Nashville’s top downtown attractions, but you’ll also enjoy resort-style amenities including:

✨ Beautiful outdoor pool
💪 Fully-equipped fitness center
🔥 Cozy fire pits & modern grill/lounge area in the courtyard
🚗 Parking available upon request (for a fee)

Whether you're here for the music, the food, a conference, a game, or the energy of the city, you’re in the center of it all:

🎶 Broadway & Honky Tonks – 3 blocks
🏒 Bridgestone Arena – 2 blocks
🎤 Music City Center – 1 block
🏈 Nissan Stadium – 1 mile
🌆 Ascend Amphitheater – 0.4 miles
🍽️ The Gulch – 0.5 miles

Sleeping Arrangements:
🛏️ 1 King Bed
🛏️ 2 Queen Beds
🛋️ 2 Twin Day Beds
🛏️ 2 Twin Trundles

Interior Highlights:

⭐️10’ Ceilings & Hardwood Floors

⭐️ Quartz Countertops & Stainless Steel GE Appliances

⭐️ In-Suite Washer & Dryer

⭐️ Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen:
* Cookware, Bakeware, Air Fryer, Slow Cooker, Rice Maker, Blender & More!
* Free Coffee

⭐️ Fresh Towels & Bathroom Essentials

⭐️Entertainment & Connectivity:
* Smart TV with HBO, Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Prime Video, YouTube – just log in and stream!
*Complimentary High-Speed WiFi

Guest access
🔑 Guest Access

☆ Digital Key Entry – For secure and seamless access to the building, apartment, and amenities, guests will use the Latch app by Latch Inc. Instructions to download and set up your digital keys will be sent before check-in.

☆ Full Access – Guests have complete access to:

The entire apartment, including the balcony and in-suite laundry

All communal amenities, including:

Lounges (Top Floor & Ground Floor)

Library

Modern gym with rock climbing wall

Resort-style pool (with rentable cabanas)

Outdoor courtyard with fire pits, grills, tables, and benches

☆ Parking –

One assigned garage parking spot is available for a nightly fee (1 car guaranteed). Must request in advance. 

Additional vehicles can use metered guest parking or nearby public lots/garages (typically $40–$60 per day).

☆ Accessibility –

No stairs required to access the unit

Well-lit hallways and entry points for safety and ease of arrival
